batch: RSAT, Hyper-V, Windows Sandbox and WSL official component source review

rsat.model: Windows client RSAT tools are individual Windows capabilities; the set is edition/build/architecture dependent.
rsat.discovery: Get-WindowsCapability -Online filtered to Name like Rsat*
rsat.dependencies: Some capability entries declare other RSAT capability dependencies.
rsat.specificReview: Windows 11 25H2 Arm64 does not support RSAT FODs; some tools are available as Windows optional features instead.
rsat.open: The user-selected role/tool set is not specified; do not create one all-tools bundle or infer a default.

hyperv.edition: Windows 11 Pro or Enterprise; Home is excluded by current Microsoft installation guidance.
hyperv.sideEffect: Enabling the feature requires an administrator and restart.
hyperv.open: Preserve existing VM/configuration data; edition, hardware, feature dependency and recovery guards need candidate design and disposable target acceptance.

sandbox.editions: Windows 10/11 supported editions; feature availability is gated by OS requirements.
requirements: Nested virtualization when the target itself is a VM
sandbox.sideEffect: Requires elevated optional-feature enablement and may require restart; opening the Sandbox is a separate action.
sandbox.security: Networking is enabled by default; network/drive exposure and .wsb configuration must remain explicit separate choices.
sandbox.open: Edition/hardware checks, parent feature requirements, config ownership and recovery need separate review.

wsl.installShortcut: wsl --install enables optional components, downloads the latest Linux kernel and Ubuntu, defaults to WSL 2, and may require restart.
wsl.implication: Do not use the default shortcut for a no-network-fallback or independent-component workflow; kernel and distribution acquisition/registration/data recovery are separate outcomes.
wsl.open: Select the WSL architecture/version path; pin or bundle required kernel/distro artifacts before any offline installation candidate.

resolved: Authoritative per-component acquisition and platform prerequisites recorded.
The four outcomes remain separate and optional; no aggregate enablement, default-profile selection, distro provisioning, Sandbox launch, or VM/data change was authorized by this review.
deferred: RSAT subtool selection and exact capability/dependency mapping.
Hyper-V existing-VM preservation, edition/hardware guards and exact restore.
Windows Sandbox parent-feature, networking/configuration ownership and exact recovery.
WSL 1/2 selection, pinned offline kernel/distro acquisition and WSL data-preserving recovery.
Disposable Windows 11/Server acceptance and VM/checkpoint inspection.
